paper.title_en: Extensions of the Algorithm Deviation Orthogonality Theorem and Their Applications
paper.abstract_en: The Algorithm Deviation Orthogonality Theorem provides a guidance on choosing data fitting algorithms deviating from the Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse without increasing fitting errors significantly from the least-square solution. This paper extends the theorem to any arbitrary matrix with wider constraints. The Wider and the General Algorithm Deviation Orthogonality Theorems are introduced. Applications of these theorems are discussed.
